card.name: Quantity words before counted groups
card.fires_on: Words and marks right where a count or amount of people or things is about to be given, such as "one", "three", "many", "a significant number", or a comma after a casualty figure. Seen in general news-style web text.

modes.label: Punctuation after a count
modes.description: A period or comma follows a statement about deaths or victims, just before more counts or outcomes.
